description: This file contains utility functions and type definitions for detecting and parsing Vitest process statistics, including process filtering based on command-line arguments and environment variables.

methods.name: parseVitestProcessStats
methods.description: Parses the output of the 'ps' command to gather statistics about Vitest-related processes.

methods.name: detectVitestProcessStats
methods.description: Detects current Vitest process statistics based on environment variables and optionally runs 'ps' command.

methods.name: shouldPrintVitestThrottle
methods.description: Determines whether to print Vitest system throttle information based on environment variable.
